CVE-2026-54873.why: OpenSSL linked statically into the cryptography wheel, found by the bundled-library scan (#811). The image has no pyOpenSSL, so nothing runs TLS, DTLS or QUIC through this copy; Python's ssl module uses the interpreter's own OpenSSL, which the OS-package scan reports. This is a TLS/DTLS/QUIC/CMP/OCSP/DANE code path.
